svg.title: The loop
svg.desc: Idea or issue: a voice rant, or a bug I hit using the app. Grill: one question at a time. Build: on a branch, never the live app. Try it: a preview copy, plus a different model's review. Ship it? My call; no goes back to Build. Fresh VM: every test, in a throwaway VM. Green? No goes back to Build: the agent reads the failure, fixes it and runs it again. Rollback rehearsal, only on the apps it is set up for: Finance, Dashboard, Tokdash. Live.
